meta.title: Docker Desktop MCP Toolkit
meta.description: Connects this Harness to the Docker MCP gateway that Docker Desktop runs, so the MCP servers enabled in your Docker MCP Toolkit profile become agent tools. The gateway starts on demand with `docker mcp gateway run`; which servers it exposes follows the profile you selected in Docker Desktop. Turn the plugin off to stop the gateway and remove its tools, and no tool runs until the agent calls one. Tools act with your Docker Desktop permissions, so a tool that writes files or runs commands changes the paths it is allowed to reach, and the gateway refuses host paths outside its allowed mount roots until an environment variable such as MCP_GATEWAY_DOCKER_BIND_ALLOWED_PATHS permits them.
